facts.why: Mike drives an advertising truck for Al's campaign. There is no campaign bus in the plot.

facts.text: Keep Mike away from the buffet until the election, Steve. One more spilled punch bowl and I'm finished.

facts.text: Drake, the jumpy vet up the mountain who thinks the trees are talking
facts.why: Drake is a crazed Vietnam vet who lives in an old school bus with a grill and weapons. Nothing says he thinks the trees are talking.
facts.fix: Drake, the jumpy vet who lives in an old school bus with a grill

facts.text: One more spill and Al's campaign is finished.
facts.why: No spill ruins Al's campaign. Mike's stunts at the Rock the Vote event are what make Al drop him from the campaign.
facts.fix: One more stunt and Al's campaign is finished.
